name: CSV Converter
description: Convert between CSV and JSON with custom delimiters, header detection and validation.

hints.input: Without a header row, CSV to JSON names the columns column1, column2 and so on.
hints.output: For JSON to CSV the columns are the sorted union of all object keys, which keeps the output stable.

faq.a: Yes, set the delimiter to a tab character.
Objects are unordered, so sorting keeps the header identical for the same data and makes diffs meaningful.
